blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic remote sensing is evaluated on how many questions it can answer, whereas crisis response depends on whether its answers can be relied on and how much of the decision can safely be handed to the agent. This paper argues that \emph{autonomy should be earned, not assumed}: An Earth-Observation (EO) agent should be granted autonomy in proportion to demonstrated reliability, epistemic honesty and verifiability. The position is supported by an evidential meta-analysis of twelve agentic RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies from peer-reviewed venues. Only one repeats runs, three contain unanswerable tasks and none measures calibration. Their own tables show that completed workflows are often not correct (task success exceeds tool-call correctness by up to 54pp on identical queries), that the gap to an expert trajectory widens overall with trajectory length (from 7 to 56pp), and that capability does not predict abstention (Spearman r from -0.25 to 0.50, all n.s.). The paper then contributes three EO-specific trust properties, an autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks, and a readiness protocol that replays archived emergency activations before any live use. In this context, current evidence justifies assistive roles only.
blocks.zh: 对代理遥感的评价是,它能回答多少问题,而危机应对则取决于其答案是否可以依赖,以及能够安全地将多少决定交给代理商。 本文主张,\emph{自治应该挣取,而不是假设}: 地球观测代理人应当按照证明的可靠性、认知诚实性和可核查性的比例获得自主权。 对来自同行审评地点的12个媒介RS/EO/GIS基准研究进行的证据元分析支持了这一立场。 只有一次重复运行,三次包含无法回答的任务,没有测量校正. 他们自己的表格显示,已完成的工作流程往往不正确(任务成功率超过工具调用正确率,在相同的查询中最高可达54pp),与专家轨迹的差距随着轨迹长度而总体扩大(从7到56pp),而且这种能力不会预测弃权(Spearman r从-0.25到0.50,所有n.s.)。 文件随后贡献出三个EO特定信任属性,一个用于危机EO任务的自主阶梯,以及一个在任何活用前重放存档紧急激活的备战协议. 在这方面,现有证据仅证明辅助作用是合理的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language model (LLM) agents that plan, call remote-sensing tools and write code are becoming the interface to Earth Observation (EO), evolving from chains of a few vision models [ 11 , 20 ] to orchestrators of many tools [ 34 , 3 ] , over a hundred in the largest [ 8 , 32 ] .
The first hours of a disaster require exactly the data discovery, rapid mapping and damage assessment these agents promise to automate [ 32 , 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
计划、调用遥感工具和写作代码的大型语言模型代理人正在成为对地观测的接口,从几个视觉模型的链条[11、20]演变为许多工具的管弦乐家[34、3],超过100个最大的[8、32]。
灾害的头几个小时需要精确的数据发现、快速绘图和破坏评估,这些物剂保证[32,18]自动化。

blocks.en:
The field measures progress by capability , the share of benchmark questions answered correctly, yet crisis response requires more.
Rapid-mapping products route rescue teams and allocate aid, and operational services subject them to quality control by the provider and an independent body [ 4 ] .
A confident wrong map is more harmful than a late or declined one, and experts in AI for disaster management call for documentation, clearly conveyed uncertainty and independent audits [ 16 ] .
The question is therefore not only can the agent answer? , but when can its answer be relied on, and how much of the decision may it take alone?
blocks.zh:
实地按能力衡量进展情况,正确回答基准问题的比例,但危机应对需要更多。
快速映射产品出行救援队伍并分配援助,业务服务对其实施质量监管,由提供者和独立机构负责[4].
自信错误的地图比迟到或倒行逆施的地图更有害,AI的灾害管理专家呼吁提供文件,明确传达了不确定性和独立审计[16].
因此,问题不仅是代理人能够回答? 但是,何时可以依赖它的答复,它能单独作出多少决定?

blocks.en:
Recent position and survey papers focus on making EO agents capable , as Munir et al . [ 24 ] propose trajectory-level metrics for EO as a distinct agentic domain and Talemi et al . [ 31 ] provide a taxonomy of single- and multi-agent systems; neither scores uncertainty or abstention, nor asks which autonomy level the evidence supports.
Autonomy levels exist for generic agents [ 7 ] and GIS [ 19 ] , and the risks of full autonomy are well argued [ 21 ] , but no work connects them to crisis EO or to published benchmark evidence.
blocks.zh:
最近的立场和调查文件侧重于使EO剂具有能力,因为Munir等人[24]为EO提出了轨迹水平的度量标准,将其作为一个独特的物剂域,Talemi等人[31]提供了单一和多物剂系统的分类;既不是不确定的分数,也不是弃权的分数,也不问证据所支持的自主程度。
通用代理商[7]和GIS[19]存在自主水平,完全自主的风险被充分论证[21],但没有工作将它们与危机EO或公布的基准证据联系起来.

blocks.en: Position. In crisis response, EO agents should earn autonomy step-by-step, by demonstrating reliability, epistemic honesty and verifiability; current evidence justifies only assistive roles. The contributions of this paper are: • An evidential meta-analysis of twelve agentic RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies from peer-reviewed venues (trust-coverage audit and re-analysis of their tables) that exposes a capability–trust gap ( Sec. 2 ); • Three EO-specific trust properties with measurable definitions ( Sec. 3 ); • An autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks that states the evidence each rung requires and where today’s agents sit ( Sec. 4 ); • A staged readiness protocol that replays archived emergency activations before any live use ( Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 立场 在应对危机时,道德操守办公室工作人员应当通过证明可靠性、直觉诚实和可核查性逐步获得自主权;目前的证据只能证明辅助作用是合理的。 本文的贡献是:对来自同行评审地点的12个代理人RS/EO/GIS基准研究(信任覆盖审计和对其表格的再分析)进行证据元分析,这些研究暴露了能力-信任差距(第2款);三个针对EO的具有可计量定义的信任特性(第3款);为EO危机任务建立一个自主梯子,说明每个运行需要的证据和今天的代理人所坐位置(第4款);一个分阶段准备状态协议,在任何实时使用之前重放紧急激活的存档(第5款)。

blocks.en: 2 Evidence: What published benchmarks reveal
blocks.zh: 2个 证据: 公布的基准显示

blocks.en:
Method. The current analysis re-visits the latest versions of twelve agentic (tool-using or code-executing) RS/EO/GIS benchmark studies, published or accepted at peer-reviewed venues between 2024 and 2026, that report per-model or per-configuration results ( Tab. 1 ).
The set comprises a selection spanning EO imagery, disaster and map-tool settings (MapEval [ 6 ] and Spatial-Agent [ 2 ] use map APIs without imagery), not a census; three are agent-method papers on shared task sets, so their evidence is not fully independent ( Sec. D ).
ThinkGeo [ 27 ] is included as an exception, because its metrics are reused by the OpenEarthAgent [ 28 ] study, while preprints without acceptance are excluded.
In general, tasks and scoring differ, so absolute accuracies are never pooled ; only within-paper contrasts are analyzed ( e.g . step-level vs . final metrics, completion vs . correctness, run-to-run spread vs . model gaps, solvable vs . unsolvable tasks).
Rank correlations are Spearman’s ρ \rho over the models of one paper and are descriptive (8–13 models).
“ ≈ \approx ” marks values read from plotted figure positions and rounded or derived quantities.
Transcriptions, derivations and limitations are given in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
方法 方法问题 目前的分析重新审视了2024至2026年期间在同行评审地点公布或接受的12个代理(工具使用或代码执行)RS/EO/GIS基准研究的最新版本,其中报告了每个模型或每个配置结果(表1)。
这套软件包括一个涵盖EO图像、灾害和地图工具设置的选择(MapEval[6]和Space-Agent[2]使用没有图像的地图API),而不是人口普查;三个是共享任务集的代理方法文件,因此其证据不完全独立(Sec.D.)。
ThinkGeo [27]作为一个例外被包括在内,因为其度量衡被"开地号"(OpenEarth Agent [28])研究所再用,而未经接受的预印被排除在外.
一般来说,任务和评分是不同的,因此绝对的快感从不集合;只有纸内对比分析(例如. step-level vs. final 度量衡, 完成 vs. 正确性, 运行到运行的扩展 vs. 模型漏洞,可溶解 vs. 无法解析的任务).
排名相关性是Spearman的 $\rho 而不是一张纸的模型,是描述性的(8–13个模型)。
“≈ 相近”标记值取自图示位置和四舍五入或推算出的数量。

blocks.en:
F1. The evaluation ecosystem does not measure trust. Out of twelve benchmarks, one repeats runs, three contain unanswerable tasks, three report monetary cost and none elicits confidence or measures calibration ( Tab. 1 ).
Four use an LLM in scoring (three as judges, one to extract answers), and three score against reference trajectories that an LLM generated.
The other nine, including the disaster-focused DORA, provide no credit for declining a question.
blocks.zh:
F1. 评价生态系统不衡量信任。 在12个基准中,1个重复,3个包含无法回答的任务,3个报告货币成本,没有获得信心或衡量标准(表1)。
四是在打分时使用一个LLM(三个是评分,一个是取出答案),三个比分比取出一个LLM产生的参考轨迹.
其他9个,包括以灾害为重点的DORA,没有为拒绝一个问题提供信用。

blocks.en:
F2. Right tools and completed runs are not correct answers. On ThinkGeo, GPT-4o’s per-step tool accuracy is 67.7%, but its end-to-end answer accuracy on optical queries is 9.8%; across 11 models, tool accuracy does not significantly predict final answers ( ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 , p = 0.23 p=0.23 ; 0.69, p = 0.02 p=0.02 , for image-grounded ones).
On OpenEarthAgent, proprietary models reach GIS tool F1 of 86.5–95.8, but answer accuracy of only 35.2–43.9%.
On identical queries, Geo-OLM’s frameworks report task “success” 8.5–54.3 pp above tool-call correctness (Magentic: 79.7 vs . 25.4; Fig. 1 a).
Even DORA’s expert gold trajectory, which uses the same perception tools, answers only 80.5% correctly.
Earth-Bench’s multiple-choice format further decouples answers from process, where LLaMA-4 scores 44.9% (above GPT-4o’s 43.7%) with parameter accuracy of 1.3%, and models without any tools reach about 37%.
blocks.zh:
F2. 正确的工具和已完成的运行不是正确的答案。 在ThinkGeo上,GPT-4o的每步工具精度为67.7%,但其在光学查询上的端到端答精度为9.8%;在11个模型中,工具精度并不能显著地预测出最终答案(^0.40\rho=0.40,p=0.23p=0.23;0.69,p=0.02p=0.02,为以图像为基准的答案).
在OpenEarth Agent上,专有模型达到了GIS工具F1的86.5–95.8,但答案精度仅为35.2–43.9%.
在同样的询问上,Geo-OLM的框架报告任务 " 成功 " 8.5-54.3页以上工具调用正确性 (Magentic:79.7 vs 25.4;图1 a).
就连DORA使用相同感知工具的专家黄金轨迹也只能正确回答80.5%.
Earth-Bench的多选择格式进一步脱钩,LLaMA-4的分数为44.9%(高于GPT-4o的43.7%),参数精度为1.3%,没有任何工具的模型达到约37%.

blocks.en:
F3. Grounding, not planning, is the bottleneck. Giving three DORA agents the gold tool order raises exact tool-sequence match by 25.6–28.9 pp, but final accuracy by only 1.1–4.4 pp.
On Earth-Bench, parameter accuracy stays at or below 31.4% for all 13 models, while tool recall reaches 78.9%.
DORA’s failure analysis attributes 56.3% of errors to pipeline composition (38.5% wiring a downstream tool to the wrong upstream mask), 20.3% to damage-semantic grounding and 14.8% to sensor–modality mismatch.
Spatial-Agent traces 79.4% of its analyzed failures to faulty API data or mismatched search results, none to plan construction, and 10.3% to wrong answers after correct execution.
Retrieval itself costs accuracy, where all 11 MapEval agents score lower when they must fetch a question’s context through map APIs, than when the same context is given (mean − 16.5 -16.5 pp).
blocks.zh:
F3. 搁浅而非规划是瓶颈。 给予3名DORA代理商的"黄金工具令"将精确的工具序列匹配提升到25.6–28.9pp,但最终精确度仅提升到1.1–4.4pp.
在地球-奔驰,所有13个模型的参数精度保持在31.4%或低于31.4%,而工具召回则达到78.9%.
DORA的故障分析将56.3%的误差归因于管道成分(38.5%的误差将下游工具接入了错误的上游口罩),20.3%的误差归因于损害-语义平地和14.8%的误差归因于传感器-模式不匹配。
Space-Agent追踪其分析出的79.4%的API数据出错或搜索结果不匹配,没有计划构建,10.3%在正确执行后错误解答.
检索本身成本精确度,即所有11个MapEval代理商在必须通过地图API获取一个问题的上下文时得分会比给出相同上下文时得分更低(意为-16.5-16.5页).

blocks.en:
F4. Reliability decays with horizon and in crisis settings, and single runs cannot rank models. The gap between DORA’s gold trajectory and the best of five plotted agents grows overall from 7 pp for 2–3 tool calls to 56 pp for 11 or more ( Fig. 1 b); GeoLLM-Engine success falls from 100% with one tool to ≈ \approx 32–70% with ten, depending on prompting.
DORA’s top-ranked agent reaches 59.2% on optical-only tasks, while its accuracy is lower on tasks that require vector (27.9%), SAR (34.1%) or multispectral+DEM+slope (17.3%) layers, where 7 of 13 models score an identical 17.27%, and highest among multi-modal tasks with DSM and thermal layers (53.4%).
OpenEarthAgent’s strongest models score 21.8–24.9% on disaster assessment, among their weakest domains, vs . 39.9–53.6% on urban and environmental tasks.
Meanwhile, the six best DORA models lie within 2.6 pp, and in GeoNatureAgent, the one benchmark with seeds, the reported spread averages ± \pm 2.4 pp (max ± \pm 4.3) and 2 of 8 adjacent rank pairs are closer than their spread.
blocks.zh:
F4. 可靠性随着地平线和危机环境而衰减,单跑不能对模型进行排序。 DORA的黄金轨迹和最佳的5个布局剂之间的差距总体上从2–3工具调用7pp增长到11个或以上的56pp(图1b);GeoLLLM-Engine成功率从1个工具的100%下降到了-\=32–70%和10个,取决于提示。
DORA的排名最高的特效在光学上达到了59.2%,而对于需要向量(27.9%)、SAR(34.1%)或多光谱+DEM+slope(17.3%)层的任务,它的精度则较低,其中13个模型中的7个得分为17.27%,在DSM和热层的多模式任务中最高(53.4%)。
OpenEarth Agency最强的模型在灾害评估方面得分21.8–24.9%,在最弱的领域中,城市和环境任务得分39.9–53.6%。
同时,6个最好的DORA模型位于2.6pp以内,在有种子的基准GeoNatureAgent中,报告的传播平均值为±\pm 2.4pp(最大±\pm 4.3),相邻的8个排名对中的2个更接近于它们的传播.

blocks.en:
F5. Capability and honesty are different axes, and retries do not account for honesty. On GeoBenchX, the model best on solvable tasks (Claude Sonnet 4, 0.55) is worst at rejecting unsolvable ones (0.17), while o4-mini rejects 0.90; in GeoNatureAgent, Gemini 2.5 Pro handles 72% of unsolvable requests vs . 50% for the most accurate model; in MapEval-API, abstention on unanswerable questions ranges from 5% to 65% and is highest for an agent ranked fourth overall ( Fig. 1 d).
On UnivEARTH, two rounds of reflexion raise correct answers (Claude-4.5-Sonnet 40.0 → \to 64.5%, GPT-5 33.1 → \to 59.3%), but 21–30% of the newly produced answers are wrong and precision among answered questions stays flat (0.72 → \to 0.71; 0.73 → \to 0.73; Fig. 1 c).
Self-correction turns failures into answers, not into reliable answers or abstentions.
blocks.zh:
F5. 能力和诚实是不同的轴心,重试并不说明诚实。 在GeoBenchX上,最擅长可溶性任务的模型(Claude Sonnet 4, 0.55)最能拒绝不可溶性任务(0.17),而o4-mini最能拒绝0.90;在GeoNatureAgent上,双子座2.5 Pro处理72%不可溶性请求对最精确模型的50%;在MapEval-API中,对不可解性问题的弃权率从5%到65%不等,对于排名第四的代理人来说是最高的(图1d).
在UnivEarth上,两轮反射产生正确答案(Claude-4.5-Sonnet 40.0~~~~到64.5%,GPT-5 33.1~~~到59.3%),但新生成的回答有21-30%是错误的,在回答的问题中精确度保持不变(0.72~~~到0.71;0.73~~~~~0.73;图1c).
自我纠正将失败转化为答案,而不是可靠的答案或弃权.

blocks.en:
F6. Scores depend on the scorer and the scaffold, and cost is rarely reported. GeoBenchX’s judges agree with humans on 88–96% of 50 calibration tasks; OpenEarthAgent’s more lenient judge raises scores by up to ≈ \approx 15 points without changing the ranking; in MapEval’s open-ended variant, an LLM judge credits Claude with 55% on unanswerable questions where manual inspection finds ≈ \approx 80%.
With the same GPT-4o-mini backbone on MapEval-API’s answerable questions, accuracy ranges from ≈ \approx 24.9% to 45.2% across five agent scaffolds and tool sets.
From Geo-OLM’s totals, cost per unit of correctness ranges from $0.044 to $0.881 across frameworks with the same model; GeoNatureAgent’s DeepSeek V3.2 reaches 93% of the best model’s accuracy at about 1/11 of its cost.
blocks.zh:
F6. 分数取决于计分器和脚手架,成本很少报告. GeoBench-X’s法官同意人类对50个校正任务的88-96 % 的看法; OpenEarth Agent 更宽松的法官在不改变排名的情况下将分数提升到相差约15分; 在 MapEval 的开放式变体中, LLM 法官的分数 Claude在无法回答的问题上占55% 人工检查发现的 大约80%
MapEval-API的回答题上有着相同的GPT-4o-mini主干线,准确度从\\\\24.9%到45.2%不等,
从Geo-OLM的总数来看,每个正确度单位的成本从0.044美元到0.881美元不等,使用同一模型的框架;GeoNatureAgent的DeepSeek V3.2以成本的1/11左右达到最佳模型准确度的93%。

blocks.en: 3 What trust means for crisis EO
blocks.zh: 3个 信任对危机意味着什么

blocks.en: Trust is defined here through three properties that an emergency service can assess, each addressing failure patterns of Sec. 2 .
blocks.zh: 这里通过紧急服务可以评估的三个属性来定义信任,每个属性处理第2节的故障模式。

blocks.en:
P1. Reliability (addresses F2–F4): The same query yields the same correct answer across repeated runs and across the natural variation of crisis data (sensor, region, season, haze and smoke).
It is measured with pass^ k k [ 35 ] , the probability that k k independent runs are all correct, estimated per task from n ≥ k n\geq k runs with c c correct as ( c k ) / ( n k ) \binom{c}{k}/\binom{n}{k} , and with accuracy on held-out events rather than held-out images.
blocks.zh:
P1. 可靠性(地址F2-F4): 同样的查询在反复进行的危机数据(传感器、区域、季节、烟雾和烟雾)的自然变化中得出同样的正确答案。
它以 pass^ k k [35] 测量, k k 独立运行的概率全部正确, 估计每个任务从 n → k n\ geq k 运行时, c 正确为 (c k) / (n k)\ binom{c}{k}/\binom{n}{k}, 并且精确于被搁置的事件而不是被搁置的图像 。

blocks.en:
P2. Epistemic honesty (addresses F5): The agent abstains when the data cannot answer and reports uncertainty that survives the tool chain.
EO provides unanswerability a concrete, physical form, where the area is cloud- or smoke-covered; no post-event acquisition exists yet (revisit gap); the resolution is too coarse for the requested object; the sensor cannot observe the quantity ( e.g . optical imagery at night); the data are stale; or the requested class is ill-defined for the product.
Abstention is scored with selective risk–coverage [ 9 , 33 ] and abstention F1 on unanswerable variants of each task.
Uncertainty must also propagate , where, indicatively, conformal segmentation [ 22 , 23 , 1 ] turns a flood mask into a set of possibly flooded pixels that covers the true extent with a marginal, distribution-free guarantee; carried through the tool chain, it bounds the flooded area and exposed population instead of a single number.
Calibration error [ 10 ] on the agent’s final confidence closes the loop.
blocks.zh:
P2. 情感诚实(地址F5): 当数据无法回答并报告在工具链中存活下来的不确定性时,代理人弃权.
EO提供了无法回答的混凝土,物理形式,其中区域被云覆盖或被烟雾覆盖;事件后获取尚不存在(重访间隙);分辨率对被请求对象过于粗糙;传感器无法观测到数量(例如晚上的光学图像);数据被分解;或者被请求的类对产品定义不清.
弃权的得分是选择性风险覆盖[9,33],对每项任务的无法回答的变体则弃权F1。
不确定性也必须传播,以示一致的分解[22、23、1]将防洪面具变成一套可能淹没的像素,以边缘的、无分布的保证覆盖真正的范围;通过工具链载入,它将被淹没地段和暴露人口相接而来,而不是一个数字。
代理商最终信心的校正错误 [10] 关闭了循环.

blocks.en:
P3. Verifiability (addresses F2 and F6): Every claim carries its evidence (scene identifiers, acquisition dates, bands, tools, parameters and intermediate masks) so that an analyst can re-run and check it. Evidence validity is defined as the share of claims whose cited evidence, when re-executed, reproduces the claim within the service’s tolerance.
Unlike an LLM judge, it is deterministic and fits the thematic and positional checks of rapid-mapping services [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
P3. 可验证性(地址F2和F6): 每项索赔都附有证据(犯罪现场识别资料、购置日期、波段、工具、参数和中间口罩),以便分析员能够重新运行和检查。 证据有效性的定义是,所援引的证据在重新执行时,在服务部门的容忍范围内重复索赔。
与LLM法官不同,它具有决定性,符合快速绘图服务的专题和位置检查[4]。

blocks.en: 4 Earning autonomy
blocks.zh: 4 挣取自主权

blocks.en: Autonomy comprises a design choice, not a by-product of capability [ 7 , 25 ] . Figure 2 adapts the five user roles of Feng et al . [ 7 ] to crisis EO, as graded automation does for driving [ 26 ] , and attaches to each rung the evidence it requires.
blocks.zh: 自主性包括设计选择,而不是能力的副产品[7、25]。 图2将冯等的5个用户角色相适应于危机EO,如分级的自动化用于驾驶[26],并附在每跑需要的证据上.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Autonomy ladder for crisis EO tasks. Rungs follow the user roles of [ 7 ] ; above each rung an example task, below it the gate ( Tab. 2 ) required to reach it. Shading: Evidence of Sec. 2 .
blocks.zh: 图2 危机应急任务的自主阶梯。 rungs跟随[7]的用户角色;在每一个rung上方有一个示例任务,在它的下方是到达它所需的门(Tab. 2). 阴影:Sec. 2的证据.

blocks.en:
The rungs. At L1 (operator) the agent retrieves scenes and answers look-ups, and must declare when no suitable scene exists.
At L2 (collaborator) it drafts products ( e.g . a flood mask) that the analyst edits, with product accuracy and an uncertainty map.
At L3 (consultant) it runs a multi-step workflow with checkpoints, requiring pass^ k k on replayed events and useful abstention.
At L4 (approver) it produces a release-ready product for human approval, requiring shadow-mode agreement with analysts and high evidence validity.
At L5 (observer) it acts without approval.
blocks.zh:
run者. 在L1(操作者)时,特工会取回场景并回答外观,必须在没有合适的场景时声明.
在L2(合作者)中,它会起草由分析师编辑的产品(如:防洪面具),产品精度和不确定性图.
在L3(顾问),它设有多步工作流程,设有检查站,在重播时需要通过=kk,并弃权。
在L4(应用)中,它生产一种供人类批准的放行准备产品,需要与分析员达成影子模式协议并具有很高的证据有效性.
在L5(观察员),它未经批准行事。

blocks.en:
Where agents stand. The capability evidence partly supports L1 and L2, where tools are often selected correctly, but retrieval and grounding errors dominate failures (F3), abstention is untested in nine of twelve benchmarks (F1, F5) and no benchmark reports uncertainty with its products.
L3 holds only for short workflows, where reliability falls beyond a few tool calls and is not separable from run-to-run noise (F4).
L4 is not supported, where completion is not correctness (F2), scores shift with the scorer (F6), and no replay or shadow-mode study of an EO agent has been published.
L5 suits only low-consequence sub-tasks such as cloud screening, since risk to people grows with autonomy [ 21 ] .
No agent has formally passed even gate R1 (no benchmark reports both pass^ k k and abstention); benchmarks must change before any rung above L2 is justified, so current evidence supports assistive roles (L1–L2) only.
blocks.zh:
特工站着的地方 能力证据部分支持L1和L2,这些工具往往被正确选取,但检索和打地错误在失败(F3)中占主导地位,在12个基准(F1、F5)中,有9个基准未测试弃权,没有基准报告其产品不确定。
L3只持有短工作流程,其中可靠性超出几个工具调用,无法从运行到运行的噪音(F4)相分离.
L4不支持,在完成不正确(F2)的情况下,与分数符(F6)的分数相变,并且没有发表过对一EO代理的回放或阴影模式研究.
L5只适合低序子任务,如云筛选,因为人们的风险随着自主性而增长[21].
没有任何代理商正式通过偶数门R1(没有基准报告既通过^ kk,也没有弃权);基准必须在L2以上的任何跑道有正当理由之前改变,所以目前的证据只支持辅助角色(L1-L2)。

blocks.en: 5 A readiness protocol
blocks.zh: 页:1 准备协议

blocks.en: Table 2 : Staged readiness protocol. Thresholds are set by the operational user; the protocol fixes the structure, not the numbers.
blocks.zh: 表2:分阶段准备协议。 阈值由操作用户设定;协议会固定结构,而不是数字.

blocks.en: Benchmarks are necessary but not sufficient, since an agent is promoted one rung of Fig. 2 only after passing the corresponding gate of Tab. 2 , and demoted on failure. R1 upgrades existing benchmarks cheaply, by repeating each task k = 5 k\!=\!5 times, adding unanswerable variants built from the EO causes of P2 (a cloudy post-event scene, a sub-meter object in 10 m data), eliciting a confidence with every answer, and reporting cost alongside accuracy, e.g . dollars per correct answer [ 14 , 13 ] . R2 , retrospective replay , is the most EO-specific step, where public archives of past emergency activations hold dated requests, the imagery then available and the products analysts delivered, so replay tests an agent against an operational reference at no risk to anyone. R3 – R5 then move from shadow runs during live events to the existing quality-control chain [ 4 ] and to conditional autonomy for sub-tasks, whose errors are cheap and quickly detected.
blocks.zh: 基准是必要的,但还不够,因为只有在经过了相应的Tab门后,才能晋升一个图2一行。 2,并因失败被降职. R1通过重复每个任务 k = 5 k\!%!5 次来便宜地提升现有基准,添加了由P2的EO原因所构建的无法回答的变体(一个多云的后事场景,一个以10米数据为单位的子米对象),获得对每个答案的信心,以及报告成本与准确性,例如每个正确答案的美元[14,13]. R2(回溯性重放)是EO最具体的一步, 以往紧急激活的公开档案保存有日期要求, 图像和产品分析师提供, R3 – R5再从直播事件期间的影子跑道转移到现有的质量控制链 [4] 并有条件的自主执行子任务,其出错便宜并被快速检测出.

blocks.en: 6 Alternative views and call to action
blocks.zh: 6个 备选意见和行动呼吁

blocks.en: “Accuracy will keep rising; trust will follow.” The GeoBenchX model most accurate on solvable tasks rejects the fewest unsolvable ones, and retries raise coverage at constant precision (F5), where trust must be targeted directly.
blocks.zh: “准确性将继续上升;信任将随之而来。” Geo BenchX 模型在可溶性任务上最精确地拒绝最少的不可溶性任务,并重试以恒定精度(F5)提高覆盖度,信任必须直接瞄准.

blocks.en: “A human is in the loop anyway.” A human can only check what is shown; without uncertainty and evidence (P2, P3), oversight of a long tool chain becomes rubber-stamping.
blocks.zh: “不管怎样,人类在圈子里。” 人只能检查所显示的东西;没有不确定性和证据(P2,P3),对一长道工具链的监督就变成了橡皮戳.

blocks.en: “Abstention makes agents less useful.” Risk–coverage curves let each service choose its operating point; a declined request costs minutes, a confident wrong map can cost lives.
blocks.zh: “放弃使代理人的用处更小。” 风险覆盖曲线让每个服务选择其操作点;一个下降的请求成本分钟,一个自信的错误地图可以使生命付出代价.

blocks.en: “Operational services already have quality control.” Agents should plug into it (R4), which needs checkable evidence (P3).
blocks.zh: “业务服务已经实行质量控制。” 特工应插入(R4),这需要可核查的证据(P3)。

blocks.en: Call to action. Benchmark builders should adopt R1, including pass^ k k over repeated runs, unanswerable EO tasks, deterministic scoring where possible and cost per correct answer. Agent developers should emit confidence and evidence with every answer and propagate tool uncertainty. Emergency services should open archived activations for replay and grant autonomy by rung, not by leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 行动呼吁。 基准构建者应采用R1,包括在重复运行中通过=kk,无法回答的道德操守办公室任务,尽可能确定评分和每个正确答案的成本。 代理开发者应当以每个答案释放出信心和证据并宣传工具不确定性. 紧急服务应当打开存档活化器进行回放,并通过rung而不是领导板授予自主权.

blocks.en: D Limitations of the current analysis
blocks.zh: D. 当前分析的局限性

blocks.en:
(i) Tasks, data and scoring differ across benchmarks, so only within-paper contrasts are interpreted, and model generations range from GPT-3.5 (2024) to GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3 (2026).
(ii) All numbers originate from the benchmark papers themselves, not from independent re-runs.
(iii) Correlations use 8–13 models and are descriptive.
(iv) A few values are taken from figures: Printed labels (DORA Fig. 7–9, UnivEARTH Fig. 5, OpenEarthAgent Fig. A3, GeoNatureAgent Fig. 4, GeoLLM-Engine Fig. 5, Spatial-Agent Fig. 3–4), bars read on grid lines (MapEval Fig. 19) and plotted positions marked ≈ \approx (OpenEarthAgent Fig. A7, GeoLLM-Engine Fig. 4).
(v) Crisis-specific evidence is concentrated in DORA; the other benchmarks contain disaster tasks as a minority or not at all, which is itself a gap for the community to close.
(vi) MapEval and Spatial-Agent test map and POI tools without imagery; their evidence is used for tool use, abstention, scaffolds and cost, not for EO perception.
(vii) Three studies are agent-method papers on shared task sets (Geo-OLM and GeoLLM-Squad within the GeoLLM-Engine environment, Spatial-Agent on MapEval-API), so their results are not independent of the benchmarks they reuse.
blocks.zh:
(一)任务,数据和评分因基准不同而不同,因此只解释纸上对比,而模型代从GBT-3.5(2024)到GBT-5.4和双子座-3(2026)不等.
(二) 所有数字取自基准文件本身,而不是独立再运行。
(三) 关联使用8-13个模型,是描述性的。
(四) 一些数值取自数字: 印刷的标签(DORA图7-9,UnivatherTH图5,OpenEarth Agent图.A3,GeoNatureAgent图4,GeoLLM-Egine Fig.5,Space-Agent Fig.3-4),网格线上读取栏杆(MapEval Fig.19)并绘制了标有\\\相(OpenEarth Agent.Ag.A7,GeoLLM-Engine Fig.4)。
(五) 与危机有关的具体证据集中在DORA;其他基准包括作为少数或根本不包括的灾害任务,这本身就是社区需要弥补的空白。
(六) MapEval和Space-Agent测试地图以及没有图像的POI工具;其证据用于工具使用,弃权,脚手架和成本,不用于EO感知.
(七) 有三项研究是关于共同任务集的代理方法文件(Geo-OLM和GeoLLM-Squad在GeoLLM-Engine环境下的空间-Agent在MapEval-API上),因此其结果不独立于其再利用的基准.
